layers.silver: business data with every person identifier replaced by a per-system UUID token
layers.bronze: raw personal data, 24 h retention - NOT exposed by this server

naming: <layer>.<system>_<source table in lower case>, e.g. silver.myproperty_invoice

esukh.description: esukh (иСӨХ) is Hubilai Tech's (HTI) app for apartment owners' associations (СӨХ) and the pilot source of the HTI data platform: a MySQL 8 database of 241 tables, restored nightly. branchId columns identify the СӨХ (branch table, 'СӨХ-ны сан'; DDL comment 'СӨХ-ын id'), and esukh.property is the residential estate; person columns are per-column UUID tokens, so a person's userId, workerId, currentUserId etc. tokens do not join to each other (claude.md G18).
esukh.refresh: nightly dump, restored 04:10 UTC, then loaded by hti_nightly

myproperty.description: MyProperty is one of Hubilai Tech's (HTI) apps, a property-management system (own Postgres 16 database) for managed buildings, rooms, owners (өмчлөгч), tenants (түрээслэгч), contracts, invoices (нэхэмжлэх) and payments; its rooms are mostly commercial, with few dwellings (сууц). People appear only as UUID tokens, and a token joins only to columns in the same token namespace (by default, the same column name).
myproperty.refresh: nightly dump (02:00 UB), restored 04:10 UTC since 2026-10-14

parkly.description: Parkly is one of Hubilai Tech's (HTI) apps: a parking system on its own PostgreSQL database covering parks, gates and branches, vehicles and access events, cameras, payments/pricing, and a delivery-vehicle parking service (69 tables). Only the tables the parkly team classified Normal are in the lake; the plate and vehicle-movement core (car, carConfig, inOutHistory, inRecord, Payments, worker, branch, ...) is classified Red and not copied, and people/vehicles appear only as UUID tokens.

sma.description: sma is the MySQL 8 database (sma_db, 34 tables) behind the 'Смарт Монгол туслах' (Smart Mongol assistant) app - users, cars, property sale/rent listings and offers, subscriptions/billing, AI assistant profiles and app logs; most of the app's KPIs are computed from it. People and cars are UUID tokens; the lake currently reflects a stale dump (newest registration 2025-12-08) until nightly loads start.
sma.refresh: nightly dump (02:00 UB) once the SMA host grants SSH access; until then the 2026-09-30 dump

smartpay.description: SmartPay is HTI's payment system (claude.md), feeding the Smart Mongol app KPIs: invoices and payments (cards, QPay and Negdi gateways), transactions and merchant settlement, fee distribution and income, merchants, invoices SmartPay issues to merchants, and VAT e-receipts (И-баримт). Source is the smartpay_db Postgres database (37 tables); 31 tables are in phase 1 under the team's columns document, people and merchants appear only as UUID tokens.
